known_facts_book1: The Nome King, named Roquat the Red, ruler of the underground Nomes beneath the mountains of Ev, whom no one loves.
Vows to destroy the Emerald City, enslave Ozma and Dorothy and all the Oz people, and recover the Magic Belt Ozma took from him.
Orders a tunnel dug under the Deadly Desert, right up to the Emerald City, to take Oz by surprise.
Makes General Guph his general after his Chief Steward Kaliko refuses the post.
Allies with the Whimsies, the Growleywogs and the Phanfasms, whom Guph recruits, to invade Oz.
Plans to march at midnight and conquer Oz by daybreak, then burn and devastate the land.
Alone refuses to drink the Water of Oblivion at the Forbidden Fountain and keeps his rage.
Is thrown into the fountain by the Scarecrow and Tin Woodman, drinks, and forgets everything he ever knew.
Is gently sent home by Ozma to order his fifty thousand Nomes to march back, remembering nothing.

known_relations_book1.General Guph: His newly appointed general, who recruits the allied armies and then knocks the King down at the fountain.
known_relations_book1.Ozma: The Ruler of Oz he means to conquer and enslave; his enemy, never his friend.
known_relations_book1.Dorothy: Whom he means to enslave along with Ozma; he cannot forgive her for the loss of his Magic Belt.
known_relations_book1.Kaliko: His Chief Steward, who refuses to be made general.
known_relations_book1.First and Foremost: The Phanfasm leader who takes over Roquat's own throne and demands to lead the invasion.

known_facts_book1: An old, ambitious Nome whom Roquat makes General of his armies to conquer Oz.
